auditMetadata.title: Zero-Context Independent Coastal, Strait, Sea-Effect (DEK) & Orographic Microclimate Audit
auditMetadata.scopeNote: Prompt header says '41 İL DOSYASI' with '(kontrol et: kıyı + geçiş kuşağı illeri!)'; the explicit backticked target list contains 45 coastal + transition province specs (27 marine-coastal + 18 inland/pass transition provinces across Marmara [excl. sovereign TR-16 Bursa], Aegean, Mediterranean, Black Sea, plus TR-18 Çankırı and TR-70 Karaman). All 45/45 files were audited and cross-fingerprinted against all 80 non-Bursa specs.

actionableDefects.summary: resolveProvinceTargetMetadata() mutates matchedSubBasinId, matchedZone, and matchedUrban on iteration i=0 (spec.subBasins[0]) inside `if (!matchedSubBasinId) matchedSubBasinId = sb.id`. On subsequent iterations with a better (lower) score, `!matchedSubBasinId` is false so `spec.subBasins[0]` stays permanently latched!
actionableDefects.synopticImpact: Any live coordinate query that omits explicit `subBasinId` collapses onto `subBasins[0]` (almost always the coastal strip). For example: Artvin Merkez (613 m) & Yusufeli canyon collapse onto `hopa_arhavi_kemalpasa_coast` (bypassing the <=0.15 Hopa-Yusufeli barrier matrix); Kastamonu Merkez (800 m) collapses onto `kure_black_sea_littoral` (bypassing the 0.06 Küre wall); İstanbul Bakırköy/Şişli (`marmara_urban_core`, uFrac=0.95) collapses onto `black_sea_north_belt` (uFrac=0.24); Hatay Antakya (`amik_asi_reyhanli_basin`) collapses onto `iskenderun_dortyol_coastal_strip` across the Amanos Mountains.
actionableDefects.orchestratorFix: In `lib/provinces/engine/province-cressman.ts:147`, hoist `const needSubBasin = !matchedSubBasinId; const needZone = !matchedZone; const needUrban = matchedUrban === undefined;` BEFORE `for (const sb of spec.subBasins)` and guard updates inside `if (score < bestScore)` using `needSubBasin`, `needZone`, and `needUrban`.

actionableDefects.summary: Two curatedSubLocations sit inside neighboring provinces' ADM1 polygons: (1) TR-17 `tr-17-kazdaglari-zirve` (39.7083, 26.8364, Sarıkız) resolves to `TR-10` Balıkesir (`exact_polygon`) even WITH `admin1='Çanakkale'` and `explicitProvinceCode='TR-17'` (>1.5 km inside TR-10), causing `/api/weather?lat=39.7083&lon=26.8364&pc=TR-17` and `/api/models` (`app/api/weather/route.ts:96`) to reject clicks on that sub-location with HTTP 400! (2) TR-33 `tr-33-sertavul-gecidi` (36.9153, 33.2694) resolves to `TR-70` Karaman (`exact_polygon`) whenever called without an `admin1` hint.
actionableDefects.orchestratorFix: Move `tr-17-kazdaglari-zirve` north onto Çanakkale's northern Kazdağları crest in Bayramiç (e.g. `lat: 39.755, lon: 26.835`, inside TR-17 polygon), and nudge `tr-33-sertavul-gecidi` ~1 km south onto Mersin's southern Sertavul portal in Mut (e.g. `lat: 36.904, lon: 33.269`, inside TR-33 polygon).

actionableDefects.summary: Windward barrier rules declare `rainShadowSpec.shadowedWindFromSectorDeg` overlapping the SAME northerly windward sector as `upslopeSpec.windFromSectorDeg` on windward sub-basins: (1) TR-34 `aydos_north_ridge_dek_barrier` applies to `black_sea_north_belt` with `upslope: 345°..60° (min 5.5 m/s)` and `shadow: 350°..40° (0.86x)`. Under moderate 15–19 km/h (4.2–5.4 m/s) 10° Poyraz/Yıldız DEK winds, Şile/Kilyos (`black_sea_north_belt`) receives `activeRegime: 'RAIN_SHADOW'` (`0.867x`), suppressing Black Sea DEK snow on the Black Sea coast while `marmara_urban_core` is omitted from `applicableSubBasins`! (2) TR-43 `DOMANIC_KOCAYAYLA_NORTH_SHIELD` overlaps `upslope: 340°..50° (min 5.0 m/s)` with `shadow: 345°..35°` on `DOMANIC_NORTH_BARRIER_SLOPE`. (3) TR-11 `TR11_BOZUYUK_ANATOLIAN_ESCARPMENT` overlaps `upslope: 325°..45°` with `shadow: 290°..335°` across 325°..335°. (4) TR-08 `kackar_karcal_coruh_rain_shadow_wall` sets `foehn: 295°..20°`, `upslope: 315°..45°`, and `shadow: 290°..30°` across both `savsat_karcal_mersivan_alpine` and `yusufeli_inner_coruh_micro_med`; at 25°..30° `bothSectorsOverlap` is false so `savsat_karcal_mersivan_alpine` gets rain-shadowed at 4..6 m/s.
actionableDefects.orchestratorFix: In `tr-34.ts`, either move northerly lee rain-shadow (`350°..40°`) into a separate barrier rule targeting `['marmara_urban_core']` (or set `aydos_north_ridge_dek_barrier` rainShadow to southerly `185°..235°` Lodos lee shadow for `black_sea_north_belt`). In `tr-43.ts`, move northerly lee shadow onto a separate rule for `KUTAHYA_CENTRAL_PLAIN` (excluding `DOMANIC_NORTH_BARRIER_SLOPE`). In `tr-11.ts`, trim `shadowedWindFromSectorDeg` to `275°..320°` so it does not overlap `325°..45°`. In `tr-08.ts`, split `savsat_karcal_mersivan_alpine` upslope into its own windward rule (or align `foehnSpec.toDeg: 45` / `shadowedWindFromSectorDeg.toDeg: 20`).

actionableDefects.summary: TR-10 `south_marmara_bandirma_sea` (`useOpenMeteoMarineApi: true`) places `sampleCoord: { lat: 40.48, lon: 27.84 }` directly on dry land in the mountainous interior of Kapıdağ Peninsula (`pointInProvincePolygon(40.48, 27.84, 'TR-10') === true`) rather than over the Sea of Marmara / Bandırma-Erdek Gulf.
actionableDefects.orchestratorFix: Move `south_marmara_bandirma_sea.sampleCoord` offshore into the southern Sea of Marmara / Bandırma Bay (e.g. `{ lat: 40.56, lon: 27.84 }` or `{ lat: 40.40, lon: 27.96 }`, where `pointInProvincePolygon === false`).

actionableDefects.summary: Eastern Black Sea coastal specs (`TR-08` Artvin, `TR-53` Rize, `TR-61` Trabzon) classify the open Eastern Black Sea (`effectiveFetchKm = 560..650 km`) as `kind: 'inland_sea'`, whereas all other 12 Black Sea coastal provinces (`TR-28, TR-34, TR-37, TR-39, TR-41, TR-52, TR-54, TR-55, TR-57, TR-67, TR-74, TR-81`) use `kind: 'open_sea'` and reserve `'inland_sea'` strictly for the Sea of Marmara and Turkish Straits.

advisories.details: Zero neighbor-province or foreign airport leakage exists in any `spec.icaoWhitelist` (45/45 strict subset compliance). However, 4 specs intentionally omit secondary/military/island aerodromes listed in `TURKEY_ICAO_WHITELIST_BY_PROVINCE` (`lib/metar-verify.ts`): TR-09 `[]` vs `['LTBD']` (note: `tr-09.ts:24` also lists `'LTBD'` inside `forbiddenNeighborAndForeignIcaos` even though LTBD is Aydın Çıldır inside TR-09!), TR-17 `['LTBH']` vs `['LTBH', 'LTFK']` (omits civilian Gökçeada Airport `LTFK`), TR-35 `['LTBJ']` vs `['LTBJ', 'LTBL']`, TR-45 `[]` vs `['LTBT']`. Existing regional tests (`reg-01`, `reg-03`, `reg-04`) assert these subset arrays; if Orchestrator aligns `LTFK` in `tr-17.ts`, update `reg-01-trakya.test.ts:82` accordingly. Order-only permutations exist in TR-10, TR-34, and TR-48.

Across the 45 specs, `inversionAndWedgeSpec.deltaPressureTopHpa` exhibits a bimodal convention split: 23 specs encode relative pressure thickness ΔP in [18, 45] hPa, while 22 specs encode absolute isobaric top pressure P_top in [850, 990] hPa. Currently unread by `province-vertical-profile.ts` (which uses `basinFloorElevationM + coldPoolMaxDepthM`), but any future consumer must normalize values >= 500 hPa as P_top vs < 200 hPa as ΔP.

TR-31 Hatay `stationOverrides['18858']` (Arsuz, `36.24, 35.7833`, matching `catalog-1102.ts`) sits on Akıncı Burnu >2.5 km seaward of the generalized ADM1 TopoJSON shoreline so `resolveProvinceCode({ lat: 36.24, lon: 35.7833 })` returns `GLOBAL`, while `mgm-dem-repair.ts` explicitly binds station `18858 -> 'TR-31'`.
